Wilton Dental Practice

Personal care.
A familiar welcome.

Dental care in Victoria, Westminster, with NHS, independent and private options.

A practice built around people.

Whether you’re coming for routine care or exploring a more complex treatment, start with a conversation about what matters to you.

Our services bring together preventive, restorative and cosmetic dentistry, with imaging and oral-surgery care. We also list skin and wellbeing services, which the team can explain when you enquire.

Ask about current appointment availability, including evening and weekend options. If you feel anxious, let the team know when arranging your visit.

Meet our team

Before you visit

Tell us what would help

Let the team know about communication, access or comfort needs before your appointment. Contact us to confirm the practice’s access arrangements.

Bring useful information

Have a current list of medicines and relevant medical history available. For imaging appointments, ask whether a referral is required.

Ask about your care

Discuss your options and request a clear explanation of the proposed treatment and costs before proceeding.

Your next step

Let’s talk about your care.

Speak with our team about an appointment at Wilton Dental.
